game.name: UFC Personal Trainer : The Ultimate Fitness System (USA, Europe)
game.desc: UFC Personal Trainer: The Ultimate Fitness System is a fitness software available on Xbox 360 and Kinect compatible. It uses the training methods of MMA fighters to make you sweat. Three real coaches come to guide you and give you their advice to motivate you and make the exercises as effective as possible.
